title: Finite direct image is exact on equivariant ind-sheaves
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime l distinct from its characteristic, and an algebraic closure Ω of Q_l. For a finite morphism f₀:X₀→Y₀ between finite-type D.k₀-schemes, the canonical ordinary direct image zlIndWeilPush on equivariant ind-objects of the actual constructible common-stage hearts [def-zl-weil-ind-sheaf-category] preserves finite colimits. It is already left exact by its defining inverse-image adjunction. No compactification, absolute separatedness, or weight is assumed.

source.place: Clause (1), exact finite direct image; Stacks 09A8 and Bhatt--Scholze 6.8.14--6.8.15 supply the underlying finite-image exactness.

proof.text: Apply the exact finite ordinary ind-heart adjunction. Both ind Frobenius functors are exact autoequivalences by the recorded ind-category theorem. The mate of the prescribed pullback square is therefore an isomorphism. Lift the adjunction along that square and its mate to invertible Frobenius pairs. Exactness on carriers implies preservation of finite colimits of this lifted right adjoint.

The lifted left adjoint is definitionally the prescribed zlIndWeilPull. Uniqueness of its right adjoint supplies the natural isomorphism from the exact lifted functor to zlIndWeilPush. Transfer preservation of finite colimits along this isomorphism. The proof uses the library mate-adjunction theorem and writes the comparison in Lean.

proof_origin.place: Exact finite ordinary image is the separate source input; the complete Frobenius-mate adjunction lift and uniqueness comparison are written in Lean.
